partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Disease-anchored causal pathway module
results.hypothesis: An inhibited causal target is more credible when it and a second causal disease gene occupy a compact process independently associated with the disease.
results.body: directly bound and decreased causal target; target and another causal gene share a compact disease-associated process
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule combines direct target perturbation, two causal disease genes, and a disease-anchored process, but the graph does not state whether reduced target activity corrects the disease.
results.trapi_notes: The positive graph motif is TRAPI-expressible; distinct-gene and process-degree constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (gene)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)
MATCH (object)-[:GENETIC_ASSOCIATION]-(process)
MATCH (other_gene:Gene)-[:CAUSES]->(object)
MATCH (other_gene)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)
WHERE other_gene <> gene
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND process._miner_gene_member_degree <= 100
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Compact dual-target causal module
results.hypothesis: A drug that directly binds and decreases two causal genes in the same compact disease process is more predictive than a single-target mechanism.
results.body: drug directly binds and decreases two causal disease genes that share a process with <=100 gene members
results.mechanism_rationale: The non-linear motif establishes convergent perturbation of a causal module, but disease-driving activity direction is absent.
results.trapi_notes: The two target paths and shared process are TRAPI-expressible; cardinality, distinctness, and process degree require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene1:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect1:AFFECTS]->(gene1)
MATCH (gene1)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene2:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect2:AFFECTS]->(gene2)
MATCH (gene2)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
MATCH (gene1)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)<-[:INVOLVED_IN]-(gene2)
WHERE gene1.id < gene2.id
  AND effect1.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect1.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect1.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND effect2.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect2.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect2.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND process._miner_gene_member_degree <= 100
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Interacting dual-target causal module
results.hypothesis: A drug that directly decreases two interacting causal disease genes identifies a coherent molecular module even when pathway annotation is incomplete.
results.body: drug directly binds and decreases two causal disease genes that directly physically interact
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule establishes convergent perturbation of an interacting causal pair, but neither interaction direction nor disease-driving activity direction is represented.
results.trapi_notes: The positive graph motif is TRAPI-expressible; two-target cardinality and distinctness require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene1:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect1:AFFECTS]->(gene1)
MATCH (gene1)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene2:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect2:AFFECTS]->(gene2)
MATCH (gene2)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
MATCH (gene1)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]-(gene2)
WHERE gene1.id < gene2.id
  AND effect1.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect1.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect1.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND effect2.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect2.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect2.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Interaction-propagated tissue pathway module
results.hypothesis: An inhibited target can propagate to a causal disease driver when both genes interact, share a compact process, and are expressed in the same disease anatomy.
results.body: drug decreases bound target; target physically interacts with causal driver; both share compact process and Bgee expression in one disease anatomy
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule integrates molecular interaction, pathway, tissue, and causal genetics, but an unsigned physical interaction does not establish corrective propagation.
results.trapi_notes: The positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; shared-node identity, Bgee provenance, and degree constraints require Cypher or post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]-(driver:Gene)
MATCH (driver)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (target)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)<-[:INVOLVED_IN]-(driver)
MATCH (target)-[target_expression:EXPRESSED_IN]->(anatomy:AnatomicalEntity)
MATCH (driver)-[driver_expression:EXPRESSED_IN]->(anatomy)
MATCH (object)-[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]->(anatomy)
WHERE target <> driver
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN coalesce(target_expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN coalesce(driver_expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND process._miner_gene_member_degree <= 100
  AND anatomy._miner_disease_location_degree <= 50
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Signed propagated tissue pathway module
results.hypothesis: Inhibiting an upstream positive regulator can reduce a causal disease driver when both genes share a compact process and disease anatomy.
results.body: drug decreases bound target; target upregulates causal driver; both share compact process and Bgee expression in one disease anatomy
results.mechanism_rationale: The signed regulatory edge supports a corrective propagation direction, but the causal disease edge still lacks gain-of-function versus loss-of-function semantics.
results.trapi_notes: The signed path is TRAPI-expressible with qualifiers; shared tissue, compactness, provenance, and identity constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[regulation:REGULATES]->(driver:Gene)
MATCH (driver)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (target)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)<-[:INVOLVED_IN]-(driver)
MATCH (target)-[target_expression:EXPRESSED_IN]->(anatomy:AnatomicalEntity)
MATCH (driver)-[driver_expression:EXPRESSED_IN]->(anatomy)
MATCH (object)-[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]->(anatomy)
WHERE target <> driver
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND regulation.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND regulation.object_direction_qualifier = 'upregulated'
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN coalesce(target_expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN coalesce(driver_expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND process._miner_gene_member_degree <= 100
  AND anatomy._miner_disease_location_degree <= 50
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Phenotype-localized tissue pathway concordance
results.hypothesis: A direct causal target is more credible when it participates in a disease-associated process and is expressed in a disease anatomy independently localized by a disease phenotype.
results.body: direct inhibited causal target with compact disease-associated process, Bgee expression in disease anatomy, and disease phenotype localized to that anatomy
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule combines causal genetics, pathway, expression, disease anatomy, and phenotype localization, but lacks disease activity direction.
results.trapi_notes: The positive motif is expressible as several TRAPI paths; shared anatomy identity, provenance, and degree constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (gene)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)
MATCH (object)-[:GENETIC_ASSOCIATION]-(process)
MATCH (gene)-[expression:EXPRESSED_IN]->(anatomy:AnatomicalEntity)
MATCH (object)-[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]->(anatomy)
MATCH (object)-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]->(:PhenotypicFeature)
      -[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]->(anatomy)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN coalesce(expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND process._miner_gene_member_degree <= 100
  AND anatomy._miner_disease_location_degree <= 50
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Independent molecular and genetic provenance architecture
results.hypothesis: A direct causal-target rule is more predictive when binding is supported by several sources and the gene-disease claim is independently supported by non-SemMed sources and relation types.
results.body: direct inhibited causal target with >=3 binding sources, >=1 non-SemMed gene-disease source, >=3 direct relation types, and >=2 causal publications
results.mechanism_rationale: Independent provenance reduces single-source artifacts around a plausible target mechanism, but cannot supply the missing disease activity direction.
results.trapi_notes: The positive causal-target motif is TRAPI-expressible; source-union cardinality and derived evidence constraints require Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[binding:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
WITH subject, object, evidence, collect(DISTINCT binding) AS bindings
WITH subject, object, evidence,
     reduce(
       sources = [],
       relation IN bindings |
       reduce(
         accumulated = sources,
         source IN coalesce(relation.primary_knowledge_sources, []) |
         CASE
           WHEN source IN accumulated THEN accumulated
           ELSE accumulated + source
         END
       )
     ) AS binding_sources
WHERE size(binding_sources) >= 3
  AND evidence._miner_non_semmed_primary_source_count >= 1
  AND evidence._miner_direct_relation_type_count >= 3
  AND evidence._miner_causal_publication_count >= 2
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Direct pathway and tissue concordance
results.hypothesis: A direct inhibited causal target supported by both a disease-associated process and repeated Bgee disease anatomy is a useful base for negative-evidence ablation.
results.body: direct inhibited causal target with direct disease process and >=2 shared Bgee disease anatomies
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule combines direct target, causal genetics, pathway, and anatomy evidence but lacks disease activity direction.
results.trapi_notes: The positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; cardinality and derived feature constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence._miner_direct_process_count > 0
  AND evidence._miner_bgee_anatomy_count >= 2
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Contradiction-gated pathway and tissue concordance
results.hypothesis: Explicit adverse, phenotype-overlap, and opposite-direction evidence can remove false positives from a pathway-and-tissue mechanism.
results.body: R101 excluding direct adverse disease edges, shared side-effect phenotypes, and opposite drug-to-gene increase assertions
results.mechanism_rationale: The positive mechanism is unchanged; graph-native contradiction gates remove candidates with evidence inconsistent with treatment.
results.trapi_notes: Positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; multiple NOT EXISTS gates and derived cardinalities require Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence._miner_direct_process_count > 0
  AND evidence._miner_bgee_anatomy_count >= 2
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:CONTRAINDICATED_IN|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|CAUSES]->(object)
  }
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(:PhenotypicFeature)
          <-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]-(object)
  }
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[opposite:AFFECTS]->(gene)
    WHERE opposite.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
      AND opposite.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
      AND opposite.object_direction_qualifier = 'increased'
  }
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Specific sibling indication transfer
results.hypothesis: A non-blind treated indication can transfer through a shared causal target to a sibling disease under a specific ontology parent.
results.body: training-treated anchor and candidate share inhibited causal target and immediate parent with 2-200 direct descendants
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule preserves a shared target mechanism and local disease ontology context, but indication transfer can still cross clinically important subtype boundaries.
results.trapi_notes: The treatment anchor, target paths, and ontology motif are TRAPI-expressible; source exclusion and parent-degree constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[treatment:TREATS|AMELIORATES_CONDITION]->(anchor:Disease)
WHERE any(
  source IN coalesce(treatment.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  WHERE NOT source IN ['infores:drug-repurposing-hub', 'infores:ttd']
)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(anchor)
MATCH (gene)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (anchor)-[:SUBCLASS_OF]->(parent:Disease)<-[:SUBCLASS_OF]-(object)
WHERE object <> anchor
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND parent._miner_disease_descendant_degree >= 2
  AND parent._miner_disease_descendant_degree <= 200
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Bounded direct-lineage indication transfer
results.hypothesis: A non-blind treated indication can transfer to a nearby ancestor or descendant when both diseases share the same inhibited causal target.
results.body: training-treated anchor and candidate share inhibited causal target and are within two disease subclass steps
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule preserves target mechanism and close ontology lineage, but treatment of a parent or child disease does not guarantee transfer across subtype boundaries.
results.trapi_notes: The positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; source exclusion and the bidirectional bounded lineage disjunction require separate TRAPI queries or Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[treatment:TREATS|AMELIORATES_CONDITION]->(anchor:Disease)
WHERE any(
  source IN coalesce(treatment.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  WHERE NOT source IN ['infores:drug-repurposing-hub', 'infores:ttd']
)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(anchor)
MATCH (gene)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
WHERE object <> anchor
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND (
    EXISTS {
      MATCH (anchor)-[:SUBCLASS_OF*1..2]->(object)
    }
    OR EXISTS {
      MATCH (object)-[:SUBCLASS_OF*1..2]->(anchor)
    }
  )
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Rare ontology phenotype corroboration
results.hypothesis: A graph-native ontology bridge between disease and gene phenotypes can corroborate a direct inhibited causal target despite identifier mismatch.
results.body: direct inhibited causal target whose disease phenotype and gene phenotype share a phenotype ancestor within two steps
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule adds phenotype concordance to a direct causal target, but the graph's gene phenotype representation is extremely sparse and hub-prone.
results.trapi_notes: The bounded ontology motif is expressible as TRAPI paths; shared ancestor identity and descendant-degree constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (object)-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]->(disease_phenotype:PhenotypicFeature)
MATCH (gene)-[:GENE_ASSOCIATED_WITH_CONDITION]->
      (gene_phenotype:PhenotypicFeature)
MATCH (disease_phenotype)-[:SUBCLASS_OF*0..2]->(ancestor:PhenotypicFeature)
      <-[:SUBCLASS_OF*0..2]-(gene_phenotype)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND coalesce(ancestor._miner_phenotype_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
